decisions.run_mode: goodnight; apply non-dangerous overnight, STAGE validate.py + render.py for morning tap, then localhost link + deploy
decisions.never_decline: STRICT: no pair may ever return 'mix cannot be created'. If nothing fits, take best available.
decisions.tempo: Vocal BPM ALWAYS matched to beat's native BPM (Version A, beat = master). Per-bar beat-locked so nothing drifts off-beat.
decisions.key_shift_ceiling: +-3 semitones, formant-preserved. Empirical chroma (AutoMashUpper) picks the shift; labels are only a prior. If no shift within +-3 is compatible, apply the empirically-best available.
decisions.key_method: AutoMashUpper cosine over beat-sync chroma, fuzzy cap, formant-preserved (base rule for Rule 1/3/4).
decisions.balance: beat-full + vocal-subtle applies to ECHO (Rule 4) and CHOP (Rule 3) ONLY. Simple (Rule 1) keeps current balance.
decisions.beat_detection: Harden + verify: confidence gate, ensure beat-lock snaps to detected downbeats, retry/flag low-confidence grids. No full detector rebuild tonight.
decisions.rules_scope: Key-match + tempo auto-match become the BASE rule under Rule 1, Rule 3, Rule 4.

research_basis: AutoMashUpper (Davies/Hamel/Yoshii/Goto ISMIR2013) - H_n(r,k) cosine over beat-sync chroma, gamma=0.2 tempo reward
Lee et al ISMIR2015 - vocal-over-instrumental; harmonic-change-balance; drop rhythmic/spectral for lead vocal
TIV.lib arXiv 2008.11529 - tonal interval space (future refinement)
Fuzzy keymixing +-2 (extend +-3 with formant correction); CDJ-3000 Key Sync
